# Rhodium Germany — Public Benchmark Evidence Register

**Historical evidence snapshot:** 7 October 2026. **Published:** 18 November 2026.

This public register exposes **558 distinct historical cold/warm report records**, their report-file SHA-256 digests and measured byte counts. The private technology core, internal procedures, secret keys, file-system locations and full raw evidence archive are **not published**. The proprietor reports possession of additional original evidence and can arrange controlled verification.

## Scope and interpretation

- All 558 reports in this historical audit were recorded as `PASS_REAL_ROUNDTRIP`. Their cold and warm sections each reported `bit_identical=true` and `hash_match=true`. These are **reported test results**, not a fresh independent rerun.
- These **558 reports are not 558 independent technologies**. Cold and warm refer to different test conditions. A warm cache can significantly reduce transmitted bytes; negative cold reduction means overhead.
- The audit also reviewed 534 Live-Proof result/summary JSON files (503 PASS, 31 status unspecified), 12 Competition files (10 PASS, 2 unspecified), 11 WORLD5-V3 files (10 PASS, 1 unspecified), and one WORLD5 file (status unspecified). These inventories may overlap; totals must not be summed as independent tests.
- Other historical inventory figures (including larger evidence registers and newer November tests) are **not merged into this 558-row register** until identifiers, hashes, scope and duplication have been reconciled.
- A report SHA-256 authenticates a particular report file **when its original bytes are available for comparison**; it is not a secret signing key or a proof that a test was independently rerun.
- Internal 52+8 lever documentation and protected core methods remain confidential. No universal performance, safety or third-party certification is claimed.
